answer: Because the timing is published against the voyage challenge, the vault audit can replay the sonnet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 41 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 3118 identities would post 3416 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
